title: Forever Fun: Forty Years of Marin Bikes
content:
Forever Fun is the official film celebrating 40 years of Marin Bikes, the mountain bike brand born in Marin County, California. Made with the creative team at Misspent Summers, it tells the story of the riders, people and ideas behind four decades of building bikes Made For Fun. Forty years ago, a bright idea in Marin County kicked off something nobody saw coming, least of all us. We built bikes that more people could ride. Suddenly, a whole new generation of riders were grinning up climbs, whooping down descents, and reaching places they never dreamed of getting to under their own steam.

The post Forever Fun: Forty Years of Marin Bikes appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
